routing.title: Routing Engine
routing.desc: Route requests to the best model or agent based on cost, latency, and capability matching.

fallback.title: Fallback Management
fallback.desc: Automatically switch to backup providers when primary routes fail. Zero downtime.

monitoring.title: Performance Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Real-time latency tracking, error rates, and cost optimization analytics.

systemFlow.title: System Flow
systemFlow.subtitle: From request to settlement — the complete lifecycle through 词元闪耀.

steps.title: User or Agent sends request

steps.title: Smart matching & routing

steps.title: Response returned

pricing.title: Unified Pricing —
